What are your typical clients?

The majority of our clients are venture-backed startups at the growth stage. Usually, at this stage, the company already achieved a product-market fit and is looking to expand rapidly. That’s where we bring the best engineering practices, strong architecture, the latest technologies, and consistent processes to help companies scale.
What is the length of your engagements?
Most of our long-term full-time engagements last multiple years. It allows you to evolve your career with the client company taking on more responsibilities.
What’s your company size?

The Right Balance team is 60+ engineers going to 100+ by the end of the year. The current client size team is 38+ people. The timing is great to be a part of a rapidly growing team making meaningful contributions.
What happens if the engagement is completed?
Most of our engagements are long-term in nature. That said, if the current engagement is ramping down, we’ll present you with more long-term opportunities to transition into.

We're looking for a Engineering Manager. Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Right Balance provides top-tier technology talent for innovative companies in the US. We’re in the top 50 companies to watch in LA.
What We Do

We're the first and largest peer-to-peer marketplace for laundry.  Our customers tap the app and outsource their laundry. For them, it’s life without laundry, because we hacked it out of existence. But we solve a second problem too, which is that more and more people of varying backgrounds want to work from home. Luckily most people have an underutilized washer/dryer, which when combined with our Laundry Pro app, provides the first-ever manual labor work-from-home gig in the world.
For all our users, we're a marketplace for a better life.
Our Progress

Perfect product market fit drove a 100x surge in users & revenue and double-digit MoM growth over the past few years. In 2021 we scaled to 500+ markets throughout the United States. In March 2022 we closed a $10m seed round which included VC investments from Headline, Origin Ventures, Starting Line VC, Ludlow Ventures, and Clean Ventures, as well as notable angel investments from Max Mullen, co-founder of Instacart, Steven Galanis, Co-founder and CEO of Cameo, Joanna Riley, CEO and co-founder of Censia, and Rob Chesnut, Chief Ethics Officer for airbnb. Significant growth continued in 2022 and 2023.
The Role

You won’t just manage engineers—you’ll orchestrate the entire tech symphony that propels our client growth. As our Engineering Manager, you’ll be the maestro of innovation, uniting a global team around big product visions and delivering features that delight our customers. From sprint planning to cultivating a high-performance culture, your leadership will ensure that our client scales at lightning speed.
While this role does not require hands-on coding, a strong technical background is essential to effectively guide engineers, make informed architectural decisions, and ensure technical excellence.
What You’ll Do
Command the Troops. Work with our globally distributed engineering squads, bridging time zones like a pro to deliver top-tier product features on time.
Drive the Roadmap. Translate ambitious goals into tangible sprint plans, ensuring everything from planning to release happens like clockwork.
Guard the Gates. Set the gold standard for code quality, security, and performance. Implement monitoring and incident response so issues get squashed before our users even notice.
Spark Innovation. Keep your radar on for emerging tools and best practices, foster continuous learning, and create a safe space for bold ideas and rapid experimentation.
Align with Stakeholders. Keep leadership informed, manage resources like a wizard, and ensure engineering efforts always sync up with our client overarching vision.
Here’s How You’ll Leave Your Mark
You’ll attract, nurture, and retain top-notch engineering talent, shaping our client's future superstar teams.
Prepare tickets, ensuring they are clear, complete, and stable (ready the week before the sprint begins)—with no need for changes and minimal need for clarification once the sprint begins.
You’ll maintain robust, scalable operations—staying two steps ahead of any hiccup and ensuring everything runs smoother than freshly ironed laundry.
You’ll foster an environment where new ideas are tested early and often, letting us stay ahead of the curve and at the cutting edge of on-demand services.
You’ll build bridges between product, design, and other teams, creating a unified force that drives our client forward.
Tech Stack
Our tech stack is mostly TypeScript, allowing engineers to implement end-to-end functionality. On the frontend we use Angular/Ionic and on the backend Firebase.
Location
Remote (with a 9am Central Time daily standup, and at least 5 hours overlapping CST).
5+ years of full-time hands-on Engineering Management experience.
3+ years of full-time hands-on Cloud Services (AWS/GCP/Firebase) experience.
3+ years of full-time hands-on Typescript experience.
3+ years of full-time hands-on Node.js experience.
2+ years of full-time hands-on Development experience.
2+ years of full-time hands-on Startup experience.
Coaching, mentoring, performance reviews — you do it all. You’re a champion for engineer growth and can guide junior devs into becoming rockstar contributors.
You juggle multiple priorities in fast-paced, async environments without breaking a sweat—and you never lose sight of the bigger picture.
You’re self-directed, thrive in ambiguity, and treat “no” as the start of “how.” You’re all about innovation and pushing boundaries.
Experience scaling products internationally or rolling out geo-based features? Even better. We love a global go-getter.
2+ years of Angular or Ionic.
Global Expansion Curiosity.

¿Cuáles son sus clientes habituales?

La mayoría de nuestros clientes son empresas de nueva creación respaldadas por capital riesgo en fase de crecimiento. Our Engineering Culture (Values)

Work Hard & Act Mature - Baseline minimum 40/h a week. The hours are not definitive of your performance, but of your discipline and dedication. This doesn't mean you have to overtime every day and push 60-80/h a week. It means every individual is mature enough to understand when to apply pressure to their team and project and when to keep it paced or take a rest.

Get Sh*t Done - Complementary to the first value, we expect everyone to deliver what they took responsibility over - end to end, meaning, it's only considered done when it's usable by all customers on production.

Ship It - Don't overthink what you are building today, don't over-engineer the solution or prepare for years in advance. Don't build/refactor what wasn't requested/approved. We will have a chance to improve anything if necessary by flagging a problem first.

Zero Bullsh*t & Brutal Honesty - We didn't gather to play games or mess around, we're a group of professionals with friendly relationships who want to build cool stuff. We're not in a high school, so we should tell if someone is messing around and not consider it a "snitching" and hold each other accountable by communicating and sharing honest feedback.

Be Empowered - You are the product. Everything online is built by you. You are trusted and expected to make moderate product and design decisions in the face of ambiguity. You become the feature expert during development and very likely know the best solution. Even if we have to redo 20% of these decisions ... we still come out wildly ahead.

Team Cohesion & Culture - Help each other. Ask questions. Answer questions. Review PRs. Propose help. Check on your team mates. Help them test their solution. Help Leads with epics. Help people who are off/sick to finish their tasks. Give feedback if someone is falling behind. This will dramatically improve your sense of belonging, help you feel safer and more appreciated and most importantly - you will build bonds with people you spend so much time with.

Trust for Transparency - You all work remotely and have the luxury of choosing your working hours (apart from intersection hours) unlike office people. Provide the needed transparency on what you do during the standup, when you are stuck - ask for help instead of trying not to look bad (""Student fallacy"") and waste time.
What we want to know as a bottom line is - when you are going to finish what you've started and commit to that date it if possible or adjust the estimations and expectations often and vocally.
Build Value to Make Money - We truly want to build something that people want to use, that will help them overcome the abysmal state of recruitment in the world both for B2B and B2C.
Having said that, we also want to make money as a company. If you have skin in the game, you should treat the product as your own, your action or inaction directly impact its success.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer. Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Right Balance provides top-tier technology talent for innovative companies in the US. We’re in the top 50 companies to watch in LA.

What We Do
Our client is the first and largest peer-to-peer marketplace for laundry. Their customers tap the app and outsource their laundry. For them, it’s life without laundry, because they hacked it out of existence. But they solve a second problem too, which is that more and more people of varying backgrounds want to work from home. Luckily, most people have an underutilized washer/dryer, which when combined with our Laundry Pro app, provides the first-ever manual labor work-from-home gig in the world.
For all their users, they're a marketplace for a better life.

Perfect product market fit drove a 100x surge in users & revenue and double-digit MoM growth over the past few years. In 2021 they scaled to 500+ markets throughout the United States. In March 2022 they closed a $10m seed round which included VC investments from Headline, Origin Ventures, Starting Line VC, Ludlow Ventures, and Clean Ventures, as well as notable angel investments from Max Mullen, co-founder of Instacart, Steven Galanis, Co-founder and CEO of Cameo, Joanna Riley, CEO and co-founder of Censia, and Rob Chesnut, Chief Ethics Officer for airbnb. Significant growth continued in 2022 and 2023.

You won’t just write code—you’ll shape the architectural vision that powers the entire client ecosystem. As our Staff Engineer, you’ll partner with our Head of Engineering to orchestrate large-scale, highly available systems, set new standards for code quality, and push the envelope of technical innovation. You’ll be the guiding force that ensures our platform remains lightning-fast, secure, and endlessly scalable.

Architect the Future: Design and implement distributed systems, microservices, and advanced database strategies (think sharding, partitioning, replication) that form the backbone of our web and mobile products.
Build at Scale: Develop both front-end and back-end solutions in TypeScript. Your code will power seamless experiences for customers and Laundry Pros across iOS, Android, and the web.
Champion Excellence: Establish best practices for security, performance optimization, and monitoring. You’ll make sure our product isn’t just good—it’s world-class.
Lead & Mentor: Guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and provide strategic technical direction. You’ll influence major decisions and shape our client’s engineering roadmap.
Push Product Velocity: Execute ambitious product goals—like dynamic geo-pricing or international expansion—while keeping the codebase clean, stable, and blazing fast.
Stay Hands-On: You love coding. You’ll spend most of your time in the trenches, building new features and ensuring our platform evolves at lightspeed.
Architectural Wizardry: You’ll spearhead system designs that handle high traffic, maintain uptime, and support fast-growing user demands.
Quality Evangelist: Through code reviews and pair programming, you’ll level up the entire team’s technical bar—no spaghetti code on your watch!
Technical Visionary: Collaborate with product and design to translate big ideas into robust, scalable solutions that keep us on the cutting edge.
Operational Maestro: Implement monitoring, alerting, and incident response strategies so they can squash bugs and anomalies before users even notice.
Innovation Engine: Spot opportunities to adopt new tools or refine existing processes, fueling our culture of continuous improvement.
Our client tech stack is mostly TypeScript, allowing engineers to implement end-to-end functionality. On the frontend they use Angular/Ionic and on the backend Firebase.

Mission-Driven Team: They work hard, innovate nonstop, and serve our community of users with passion.
